title: New Orleans pimps, and the uptown clubs and big band halls
summary: He says New Orleans pimps trained those in Houston and New York, names local pimps, then lists clubs such as the Dew Drop, Robin Hood and the Pythian Temple.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
